name: floria-selfdock
description: A friendly self-hosted Docker dashboard in Material 3 Expressive style. Part of FloriaApps.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n servidor,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/server" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/web && npm run build -w apps/server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
